caption:
Turn your photos into a single PDF 📄

1️⃣ Open pdf.315tools.com and pick Images to PDF
2️⃣ Add your photos and use the arrows to set the order
3️⃣ Pick A4 or Letter, then press Create PDF

Handy for receipts, photographed documents and screenshots. Each image becomes one page, and your photos stay on your device.
